bullets: A three way tie at the top: Ctrl Alt Deligt, JimSmiley Loves LUFC and The Spice Boys all sit on 175 points.
JimSmiley Loves LUFC posted the week's highest score with 128 points on a Bench Boost, climbing 14 places from 15th into a share of first.
Ctrl Alt Deligt and The Spice Boys both put up 127, and The Spice Boys did it on the other Bench Boost of the week.
Ming Dynasty gave up the outright lead despite 109 points, sliding from 1st to 4th on 171.
McCarren Park FC was the biggest faller, down 11 places to 14th on 140 after a quiet 87.
Michael's Team had the toughest week with 60 points, the lowest in the league, against a median that jumped to 100 from 49 in the opener.
B.Fernandes was both the most captained pick, 12 of 21 armbands, and the highest scoring player owned in this league, returning 23 points.
Transfers finally started: 9 were made across the league in Gameweek 2.
